title: Generac signs Amazon backup-generator supply deal worth up to USD 8bn
description: Generac signed a long-term supply agreement to provide backup generators for Amazon data centres, with initial deliveries of about USD 2.4bn across 2027 and 2028 and milestones extending up to USD 8bn of payments. Amazon received a warrant for up to 1,693,745 Generac shares tied to payments received.
quote: Initial deliveries under the agreement are expected to total approximately $2.4 billion during 2027 and 2028.
analysis: A hyperscaler locking a large-megawatt genset supplier into 2027-28 slots tightens global supply of data-centre sets and signals Generac is now a credible large-genset rival. Cummins Arabia should confirm its own 2027-28 slot allocation for Gulf hyperscale projects and use any lead-time advantage in current bids.

title: Cummins and EquipmentShare plan 1 GW natural-gas mobile power fleet using C1400N6C sets
description: EquipmentShare and Cummins announced a multi-year collaboration, with EquipmentShare's fleet expected to grow to 1 GW of natural-gas generation. The core unit is the Cummins C1400N6C, a 60 Hz continuous lean-burn gas set of 1400-1750 kVA.
quote: the C1400N6C, a 60Hz continuous lean burn gas generator set capable of delivering between 1400 - 1750 kVA of power
analysis: Cummins is placing large continuous-duty gas sets through a rental channel, which validates gas gensets as prime power and pulls factory output toward US rental. Cummins Arabia should ask Cummins for C1400N6C-class gas availability for Gulf prime-power and rental customers before the US fleet absorbs the slots.

title: Rolls-Royce licenses mtu Series 2000 local production to Saudi Arabia's MAKEEN
description: Rolls-Royce Power Systems and Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (MAKEEN) signed an Individual License Agreement for mtu Series 2000 marine engines, the first high-speed engine maker to license local production in Saudi Arabia. The partners will now build the capabilities needed for customer projects; no volumes were disclosed and the release does not mention gensets.
quote: Rolls-Royce and MAKEEN have signed an Individual License Agreement (ILA) for mtu Series 2000 marine engines
analysis: mtu now has a Saudi local-production partner, and the Series 2000 is also a common genset engine, so a later extension to power generation (estimate, not stated in the release) would give mtu a localisation argument in Saudi tenders. Cummins Arabia should check whether local-content scoring in Saudi genset tenders could start to favour mtu and prepare its own localisation case.

title: Rehlko redesigns KG Series gas gensets, six EPA-certified models of 80-200 kW at 60 Hz
description: Rehlko introduced six redesigned KG Series gaseous generators (KG80 to KG200) for 60 Hz standby use, on 6.2 L and 10.3 L Rehlko engines with a 2-year warranty extendable to 5 years. Target sites include healthcare, water treatment and telecom.
quote: Rehlko is strengthening its KG Series gaseous generator portfolio with six EPA-certified models for 60 Hz applications
analysis: This is a small-set, US-emissions-certified 60 Hz range, below Cummins Arabia's data-centre core, so direct Gulf impact is limited and applies only to the 60 Hz parts of KSA. Cummins Arabia should check whether Rehlko dealers in KSA start quoting KG gas sets for hospital and water-utility standby.

title: Caterpillar supplies two Cat G3500K island-mode gas gensets to a Kazakhstan gold mine
description: Caterpillar, through dealer Borusan Cat, is supplying two Cat G3500K gas generator sets in a containerised enclosure to an off-grid gold mine in Aktobe, about 300 km from the nearest city. Operating range is -30C to above 30C and a Customer Value Agreement is planned after commissioning.
quote: The Cat G3500K gas power solution is designed to operate in island mode independent from the grid
analysis: Cat is packaging gas gensets with a service agreement for off-grid sites, the same offer Gulf dealers can take to remote mining, giga-project and camp power. Cummins Arabia should price a matching gas-plus-service package for KSA off-grid and mining prospects.

title: Perkins to show 5016 large electronic-injection genset engine at Tech Week Singapore 2026
description: Perkins said it will exhibit the 5016 large electronic fuel injection engine at Tech Week Singapore 2026 (stand L20), positioning the sets for data centres, power stations, rental and hospitals. The release gives no kVA, emissions or availability figures.
quote: This series of generator sets is widely deployed in data centers, power stations, rental applications and hospitals
analysis: Perkins keeps pushing the 5016 (FG Wilson sets) as a data-centre option at the upper end of its range, a price-led alternative in Gulf colocation and edge sites. Cummins Arabia should compare 5016-based FG Wilson quotes against its own 1.5-2.5 MVA offers on current bids.

title: Wärtsilä books 282 MW US data-centre onsite plant on 15 Wärtsilä 50SG gas engines
description: Wärtsilä will supply 15 Wärtsilä 50SG engines for a 282 MW onsite power plant at a US data centre, delivery in 2028 and full operation in 2029. It is Wärtsilä's seventh US data-centre order, taking sold US data-centre capacity above 3 GW.
quote: The Wärtsilä equipment is scheduled for delivery in 2028, and the project is expected to become fully operational in 2029.
analysis: Engine plants are being booked 2-3 years out for data-centre prime power, which shows how far gas capacity is sold forward and why delivery slots now decide awards. Cummins Arabia should treat 2028 delivery as the benchmark when quoting Gulf data-centre gas or diesel sets.

title: Wärtsilä, Schneider Electric and Stanley Consultants launch 'generator-to-chip' data-centre power offer
description: The three companies introduced a coordinated approach combining onsite engine generation, electrical infrastructure and engineering to speed US data-centre power delivery. Wärtsilä supplies modular engine plants, Schneider the electrical and digital power management.
quote: For many data center projects, power has become the schedule.
analysis: Engine makers are bundling generation, switchgear and controls into one delivery package, which competes with a genset-only supplier on schedule. Cummins Arabia should offer Gulf hyperscale customers a comparable package (sets, paralleling switchgear, controls, commissioning) with one delivery date.

title: Trina Storage previews gas-plus-battery 'Elementa Hybrid Genset' for AI data centres
description: Trina Storage showed a platform pairing a gas-fired plant with grid-forming containerised batteries so a data centre can energise without a utility connection. Commercial launch is planned at RE+ 2026 in Las Vegas.
quote: Trina expects to launch this hybrid platform commercially at RE+2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada.
analysis: Battery makers are entering the genset space with grid-forming BESS that rides fast load swings, which could shrink the number of gensets specified per hall. Cummins Arabia should be ready with its own genset-plus-BESS option (Cummins announced on 18 Aug it was selected to supply BESS for a US data-centre project) for Gulf prime-power tenders.

title: 2G Energy wins 275 MW order from Energy Vault for US AI-infrastructure power systems
description: 2G Energy AG received a 275 MW order from Energy Vault for containerised power systems for AI and data-centre customers including hyperscalers. Delivery runs Q4 2027 to Q3 2028 and 2G is building a second production site at Heek, Germany, due end-2027.
quote: Through long-term service, we also support their reliable operation throughout the entire lifecycle.
analysis: Another gas-engine supplier is committing its output to US AI sites into late 2028, which adds to the tightness in packaged gas gensets. Cummins Arabia should expect gas-set lead times to stay long and flag this to Gulf prime-power prospects early.
